facts.fact: 112 is the integrated emergency helpline (ERSS: police, fire and rescue, health services)
facts.quote: 112 Loading... Integrated Helpline (Emergency Response Support System (ERSS) Police, Fire & Rescue, Health services etc)

facts.fact: 108 is the ambulance emergency response number for critical care, trauma and accident patients
facts.quote: Dial 108 is predominantly an emergency response system, primarily designed to attend to patients of critical care, trauma and accident victims etc.

summary: Emergency numbers named in the expected answer confirmed: 112 (ERSS, india.gov.in helpline directory) and 108 ambulance emergency response (NHM).
